scope: E1 feedback-side-channel closure, scientific interpretation, E2 content/placebo isolation and meaning of hypothesis/learning outcomes
scientific_limits: feedback-hidden checkpoint still encodes training outcomes; effect is explicit-channel conditional effect
permutation that creates obvious contradictions is a stress test, not proof of scientific feedback use
a condition-test graph is not semantic falsifiability or hypothesis confirmation
single-batch row gain is not long-run AULC or causal value of a single chemical test
future_protocol_notes: Randomize and block arm request order to reduce time/provider drift; preserve served-model identity and blind scientific adjudication.

If the model pilot is skipped or does not identify a usable training-noise range, the proposed noise-based Go gate is unavailable and must be calibrated under an explicitly authorized fixed-label replicate experiment rather than treating NA as passing.
